nodes.label: Compose backend service
nodes.rationale: Builds apps/backend/Dockerfile, waits for healthy PostgreSQL and runs production on port 4000; protected /api/health returning 401 is the configured health success condition.

nodes.label: Compose frontend service
nodes.rationale: Builds apps/frontend/Dockerfile with public API URL as a build argument, waits for healthy backend and maps default host 3200 to container 3000; login page is health-checked.

nodes.label: azatech-postgres database container
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL 16 Alpine maps host 5434 to container 5432 because host 5432/5433 are already used by native Windows PostgreSQL services.

nodes.label: Authentication endpoint and cookie contract
nodes.rationale: Login returns 900-second access token; seven-day HttpOnly SameSite=Lax refresh cookie is scoped to /api/auth and Secure in production. Refresh rotates, logout revokes, and browser credentials/origin rules apply.

nodes.label: GET /dashboard/summary
nodes.rationale: RepeatableRead snapshot provides consistent all-time totals, top five products by quantity including archived products, and active low-stock products below five.

nodes.label: GET /orders/export CSV/XLSX contract
nodes.rationale: Authenticated attachment response with no-store, filters shared with history, pagination ignored, BOM/CRLF CSV or two-sheet XLSX, formula-safe text and archived relations. Client refreshes before retry and reads exposed Content-Disposition.

nodes.label: Product and customer CRUD contract
nodes.rationale: Paginated active masters, soft delete, strict editable fields, non-reusable product codes, absolute stock adjustment and server-generated customer UUIDs.

nodes.label: Order create, history and detail endpoints
nodes.norm_label: order create, history and detail endpoints

nodes.label: OpenCode and Context7 usage disclosure
nodes.rationale: OpenCode supported analysis, planning, implementation, tests and documentation; Context7 supplied library references, with candidate responsibility for understanding and maintaining the result.

nodes.label: Express 5 backend service
nodes.rationale: Explicit routing and centralized native async error handling; all business logic and database access remain in the backend.

nodes.label: Daily sales dashboard and Recharts
nodes.rationale: Zero-filled daily series, 7/30/90-day controls, responsive SVG and keyboard access complement a complete daily table; headline cards remain all-time.

nodes.label: pnpm db:bootstrap and idempotent seed
nodes.rationale: Wait for database health, generate Prisma Client, migrate and seed without resetting data; seed provides one admin, 20 products, 15 customers and up to 30 demo orders. Separate db:seed:auth creates only an admin.

nodes.label: pnpm env:setup
nodes.rationale: Generate missing local configuration, random JWT secrets and seed-admin password while retaining existing values; credentials remain in Git-ignored environment files.

nodes.label: Filtered CSV and ExcelJS history export
nodes.norm_label: filtered csv and exceljs history export
nodes.rationale: Export every matching order across pages using historical price snapshots; CSV neutralizes formulas and Excel separates order/item sheets. Current in-memory generation motivates future streaming or background jobs.

nodes.label: React 19 and Next.js 16 App Router frontend
nodes.norm_label: react 19 and next.js 16 app router frontend
nodes.rationale: Page routing and layout composition in a separately runnable service; browser calls the Express REST API.

nodes.label: OpenAPI 3.0.3 and Swagger UI Express
nodes.rationale: Interactive request/response contracts, authentication and business examples; source contract is apps/backend/src/docs/openapi.ts and validation uses Swagger Parser.

nodes.label: pnpm 10 workspaces
nodes.rationale: Central dependencies and commands while keeping backend and frontend independently runnable; setup pins pnpm 10.33.0.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 16
nodes.rationale: Constraints, transactions, row locks and advisory locks protect stock and order-number integrity.

nodes.label: Prisma 6.19.3
nodes.rationale: Type-safe queries, controlled migrations, Decimal money arithmetic and continuity with the existing foundation.

nodes.label: TanStack Query server state
nodes.rationale: Caching, request status, mutation invalidation and refetch avoid repeated manual fetch state.

nodes.label: Vitest, Supertest and Playwright verification
nodes.rationale: Real PostgreSQL integration tests verify transactions without mocks; separate test and E2E databases isolate data, and production browser runs verify desktop/mobile user flows.

nodes.label: Business JSON envelope and public data types
nodes.norm_label: business json envelope and public data types
nodes.rationale: Success/data/meta and failure/errors envelopes use snake_case public fields, safe numeric IDs, decimal strings and UTC timestamps. Deletes have no body; OpenAPI and successful exports are exceptions. Error item indices preserve request order.

nodes.label: esbuild permitted dependency build script
nodes.rationale: esbuild needs its postinstall script, so it is included in onlyBuiltDependencies.

nodes.label: Prisma permitted dependency build scripts
nodes.rationale: pnpm 10 blocks postinstall scripts by default; @prisma/client, @prisma/engines and prisma are explicitly allowed because their scripts are needed.

nodes.label: Atomic multi-item order transaction
nodes.rationale: Validate 1-100 distinct products, lock active masters, snapshot prices, allocate a number, save items and decrement stock in one transaction. Commit precedes 201; any failure rolls back; only transient conflicts retry up to three attempts.

nodes.label: JWT access and rotating refresh sessions
nodes.norm_label: jwt access and rotating refresh sessions
nodes.rationale: Short-lived access tokens and revocable rotated refresh tokens; SHA256 refresh hashes and session checks make logout immediately effective. Cross-tab refresh synchronization is not implemented.

nodes.label: Prisma.Decimal historical price snapshot
nodes.rationale: Exact decimal unit prices and totals preserve historical transaction prices; money is serialized as two-decimal strings, while names follow current master data.

nodes.label: Planned order idempotency key
nodes.rationale: Not implemented; prioritized to prevent duplicate orders when clients retry after losing a response.

nodes.label: Asia/Jakarta business calendar
nodes.rationale: Timezone-aware storage and inclusive Indonesian date filters mapped to a half-open interval keep numbering, history and daily sales aligned with the business calendar.

nodes.label: INV-YYYYMMDD-XXXX daily order numbering
nodes.rationale: Transaction-scoped advisory lock per Jakarta date serializes allocation; a unique constraint remains a backstop. More than 9999 orders per day is rejected with 409.

nodes.label: Customer FOR SHARE and ordered product FOR UPDATE locks
nodes.norm_label: customer for share and ordered product for update locks
nodes.rationale: Customer shared lock prevents concurrent soft deletion; product locks in ID order reduce deadlocks and prevent overselling. Stock and prices are read after locking.

nodes.label: Soft-delete historical master relationships
nodes.rationale: No cascading deletion from customers/products preserves history; archived product codes remain reserved, historical prices are snapshots, and historical names follow current masters.

nodes.label: Zod strict boundary validation
nodes.rationale: One body/query/parameter validation boundary maps indexed field errors to UI and rejects client-supplied authoritative order fields.
